message.content: The Communications Solutions Group reported operating income of $458 million compared to $246 million last year, driven by revenue growth that the document attributes to 56 percent expansion in commercial communications and 14 percent growth in aerospace, defense, and government markets [D1]. The Electronic Industrial Solutions Group posted operating income of $155 million versus $92 million previously, reflecting growth across semiconductor, general electronics, automotive, and energy markets as stated in the release [D1]. Total segment operating income rose to $613 million from $338 million, a shift supported by strong performance in both reportable segments that enabled the company to sustain momentum [D1]. The Communications Solutions Group saw its gross margin expand while the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group improved its gross margin according to the segment results table [D1].
